title: Post-drought runoff deficits in Australia occurred only after droughts that ended in 1997-2010, and the eastern US had a post-1997 runoff shift of similar size without a drought (CAMELS, 1951-2025)
abstract: Prior campaign work found that Victorian catchments stayed in a low-runoff state after the Millennium Drought, but US reference catchments did not stay low after droughts. We applied the same US event-study code to 561 CAMELS-AUS v2.03 catchments (1951-2021; 255 had qualifying droughts and long enough records) and compared the result with 555 CAMELS-US catchments (1951-2025). The method does not explain the contrast: Australian post-drought runoff was 0.28 SD below a rainfall-runoff reference (427 droughts; time-shift placebo p = 0.018), against 0.04 SD in the US. Australian catchments are not generally more sensitive: droughts that ended before 1997 gave -0.04 SD, the same as US droughts. Droughts that ended in 1997-2010 gave -0.53 SD; in 84 catchments with droughts in both periods the change was -0.50 SD (95% spatial-block interval -0.72 to -0.24). Drought length, severity, 10-year rainfall deficit, drought temperature and post-drought rain do not explain this era effect (adjusted coefficient -0.56 SD). Relative to a 1951-1996 calibration, south-east Australian runoff was 0.73-0.79 SD low in 1997-2021, and it was also low where the local rainfall deficit was small (intercept -0.45 SD). The eastern US had a shift of similar size at the same time (-0.39 SD in 1997-2009, -0.47 SD in 2010-2025) with normal to wet conditions. At equal local rainfall anomaly, the two regions did not differ after 2009. Daymet rainfall confirmed the eastern US shift (-0.54 SD). Thus the contrast comes from timing: a regional decrease in runoff per unit rain started in both regions in 1997-1999. In Australia it coincided with a long drought and looked like non-recovery; drought-conditioned tests miss the US shift. The size of the Australian shift depends on the rainfall product (SILO gives about half of the AGCD value), most explanatory tests are post hoc, and the physical cause was not tested.
